input.brief: T3R: componentes de bicicleta directos de fábrica, probados por tres riders, packaging de cartón sin adornos, precio honesto

direction.name: One motif
direction.idea: Take one shape from the subject and let it run the whole system. A drilling tool's octagonal cross-section becomes the buttons, the image masks and the loader. A two-account money app becomes two circles that recur as icon, inline dot and section colour. A café's striped awning becomes every band on the page. Look at the product, the logo, the object or the word in the headline and find the simplest geometry in it (a circle, an arc, a chamfer, a stripe, a notch, a ring). Then use only that shape, at three or four very different scales, everywhere a designer would normally reach for a generic rounded rectangle.
direction.composition: Hero: the motif appears once at enormous scale as a flat filled shape, cropped by the viewport (a circle 120vh across entering from the right, a chamfered block filling the lower half), with a short headline at 6–8vw and one supporting sentence set on the remaining ground, left-aligned on a shared margin. Through the page the motif returns as: the mask for every photograph (via `clip-path` or `border-radius` made from the same geometry), the shape of the primary button, the bullet beside list items at text size, and one full-width band that separates the two halves of the page. Sections use simple two-column or single-column layouts so the shape is the only thing with character.
direction.typography: A clean geometric or grotesk face that echoes the shape (round bowls for circles, squared terminals for chamfers). Medium weight; headings 6–8vw in the hero and 3–4vw after.
direction.colour: The motif carries the accent colour at large scale, flat. Everything else is ground and ink. A second motif colour is allowed only if the subject has a real pair (two accounts, two modes).
direction.imagery: Photographs appear inside the motif's shape. If there is product interface to show, it sits on a flat colour stage shaped by the motif. Draw the shape with CSS or a simple inline SVG path; do not draw illustrations.
direction.richness: One shape at many sizes. The giant cropped shape gives the hero mass and colour without a single image.
direction.pitfalls: One motif means one. A circle here, a hexagon there and a blob behind is the generated look this replaces. The motif must come from the subject and you must be able to say from where in one clause.

hero.name: Giant cropped shape
hero.blueprint: A plain ground with one flat shape at enormous scale. The shape is the simplest geometry found in the subject (a circle, a ring segment, a chamfered block, an arch), drawn in CSS or as a single inline SVG path and filled with the accent colour. It is about 120vh across and enters from the right, centred near 78% of the width and 55% of the height, so the top, right and bottom edges of the viewport crop it and its left boundary reaches column 7. If the subject has a true pair (two accounts, two modes), a second shape in a second flat colour overlaps the first by a quarter with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. The headline sits on the bare ground on columns 1–6, vertically centred, flush left at 8% from the left edge: two lines at clamp(64px, 6.4vw, 100px), heavy weight, tracking -0.03em. Beneath it comes one supporting sentence at 19px, then the single action as a solid button cut to the same shape. A bold wordmark sits top-left at 32px; up to three text links sit top-right in the ground colour.
hero.mobile: The shape moves to the bottom: 130vw across, centred horizontally, its top at 56svh, cropped by the left, right and bottom edges. The headline sits above it at 11.5vw on two lines at a 16px margin, starting 15% down, with the sentence at 16px and the motif-shaped button beneath. Wordmark top-left; the links collapse to one word top-right.
hero.headline: Two lines of two or three words each, up to about 12 characters per line at 6.4vw.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Object on a disc
sections.blueprint: One section about a viewport tall on a plain ground. A flat filled disc 64vh across, in one palette colour, sits with its centre at 58% of the width; swap the disc for the subject's own shape if it has one. A cut-out object photograph stands in front of it, centred on it, about 78% of the disc's height and breaking the disc's outline at the top. Bottom-left, starting on the margin and ending level with the disc's lower edge: a vertical list of four to six item names at clamp(28px, 2.9vw, 44px), leading 1.15. The selected name is in full ink and the rest at 25%; choosing a name swaps the object (300ms crossfade) and the disc's colour. The heading, two to four words at the same size as the names but in the soft ink, is the first line of that list. One fact about the selected item sits at the disc's right edge at 17px.
sections.mobile: The disc comes first, 86vw across and centred, with the object in front. The names follow as a single sideways-scrolling line at 26px with 24px gaps, the selected one in full ink. The fact sits under the names at 16px.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: Statement with inline thumbnails
sections.blueprint: A centred statement of 18–28 words, four lines at clamp(32px, 4.2vw, 62px), medium or bold weight, leading 1.12, in a block 60–66% of the viewport wide with 22vh of empty ground above and below. Three to five small frames sit inline between words: each is an `inline-block` 0.85em tall and 0.85–1.3em wide, `vertical-align: -0.1em`, radius 0.14em, holding a tightly cropped photograph (or a crop of real interface) of the thing the neighbouring word names. Frames are part of the line, never floating over it, with 0.12em of space either side. No heading above and no paragraph below; the statement is set as a `p`. Directly under the section the page may split into two flat colour halves or begin the first product row, so the thumbnails read as a preview of what follows. On a motif-driven page every frame takes the motif's shape.
sections.mobile: Left-aligned instead of centred, at 8vw with leading 1.15, about seven lines inside 20px margins. Keep at most three inline frames, each exactly one cap-height tall, and make sure none lands at the start of a line. Vertical padding drops to 96px.

sections.name: Inset panel, shaped portrait
sections.blueprint: A deep-toned panel inset 20px from the page edges with a 12px radius, about 110svh tall, `overflow: hidden`. Left half: a two-line statement of four to seven words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 64px) in a pale ink, top-left with 56px padding; it is the heading and has nothing above it. Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.
sections.mobile: The panel is inset 10px and stacks: the statement at 8.5vw, then the two text blocks at full width, the button, and last the shaped photograph at 86vw across, centred and cropped by the panel's bottom edge by a quarter of its height.

sections.name: One frame, contents change
sections.blueprint: Instead of many pictures side by side, one frame stays in place and its contents change. The frame is small and exact: 300px square on a quiet page, or up to 40vw at 4:5 on an object-led one, centred or sitting on the text column's left edge, with at least 20vh of empty ground above and below. Five to seven photographs are stacked inside it with `position: absolute` and crossfade in turn (opacity over 600ms, each held for 2.4 seconds, via CSS keyframes with staggered delays). All are shot or cropped alike: same scale, same light direction, the subject at the same position, so only the subject seems to change. On a flat ground use `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so studio backgrounds vanish. One caption line at 14px sits 16px below the frame and changes with the image. No arrows and no counter. On a motif-led page the frame takes the motif's shape through `clip-path`.
sections.mobile: The frame is 72vw wide, centred, in a section 70svh tall. The crossfade continues on its own; tapping the frame advances to the next image at once. The caption sits beneath, centred, at 14px. When reduced motion is requested the first image holds and tapping still advances.

sections.name: Paragraph with picture words
sections.blueprint: One paragraph does the work of a feature grid. Three or four sentences, 35–50 words in total, set at clamp(30px, 3.6vw, 60px), leading 1.18, medium weight, across columns 1–11, left-aligned. Each sentence names one capability, and directly after that capability's key noun sits an inline slot: an inline-block frame 1em tall and 1.9em wide, radius 0.18em, dropped 0.12em below the baseline, holding a tight photograph crop (object-fit: cover) or a real interface control at readable size. Four slots at most, never two on one line. The nouns keep the weight and colour of the rest; the slots are the only emphasis. Mark it up as a paragraph and give the section a visually hidden heading of two or three words; nothing visible sits above. 72px lower, starting at column 7, one supporting sentence at 18px and the action.
sections.mobile: The paragraph drops to 7vw with leading 1.22 and fills the width. Slots stay inline at 1em tall but narrow to 1.5em wide. If a slot lands alone at the start of a line, let it; do not shrink the type. The supporting sentence and the action follow at full width.

Below it a photograph of the person or the workshop, masked with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask` to one bold shape taken from the subject (a four-lobed flower, a circle, an arch, a chamfered block), 38vw across, positioned so the panel's bottom edge crops its lowest fifth. Right side, starting at 63% of the width and 56px from the top: two text blocks 300px wide and 64px apart, each a subhead at 22px over a four-line paragraph at 15px; then one solid button in the accent colour. Between the statement and the text blocks the panel is empty. One photograph only.

sections.name: One word is the button
sections.blueprint: The entire band is one link. A full-bleed field in the accent colour, about 60svh tall, contains a single verb of four to eight letters set at 24–30vw in the heaviest weight, tight tracking, sized with `clamp()` so it spans the content width on one line with its baseline 24px above the bottom edge. The `<a>` wraps the whole band; on hover and focus the field and the word swap colours instantly. In the top-left corner, at 20px, one sentence says what happens next; in the top-right, an arrow drawn as a simple inline SVG, 48px, points up and right. There is no other button anywhere in the section. In a page with a motif, the band's top corners take the motif's shape (a large radius, or a chamfer cut with `clip-path`). Keep the word honest: the action itself, not a slogan.
sections.mobile: The band is 46svh tall. The word is set at whatever size fills the width on one line; choose a shorter verb rather than going below 22vw. Sentence top-left at 17px across two lines, arrow top-right at 32px. The whole band stays tappable.

references.name: Midnight
references.idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
references.hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
references.type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
references.colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
references.imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
references.layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

references.name: Superlocal 2026
references.idea: Everything is a circle: a dot-matrix logotype whose dots become floating photo circles and glowing orbs across a grey-to-orange field.
references.hero: Mid-grey field with a faint dot grid (one dot every 33px) that fades through the lower half into saturated orange at the bottom edge. The captured first paint contains one element: a 270×80px logotype dead centre, built from black ellipses of varying size, its letters progressively compressed to the right. No nav or text yet. After loading, a cluster of four small pills (one black, three white) appears top-centre; the logo turns white inside a 330px ring of about fifty tiny circles — round photo crops, glowing orbs, coins; and the bottom edge carries the event name left and dates right in an outlined dot-matrix face 40px tall.
references.type: Display text is an outlined dot-matrix face drawn on canvas, about 40px caps, modules flickering. All other text is one tight bold grotesk ('fontSans') from 12 to 24px with negative tracking. The logotype is built from ellipses on the same matrix.
references.colour: #bcbcbc #ff641e #1a1302 #ffb740 #c13bff #ffffff — Every screen repeats a vertical fade from flat grey to hot orange. Orbs add magenta-violet cores; the footer swaps to a soft yellow glow. Text is near-black, nav pills black and white.
references.imagery: Event photographs cropped to circles from 60 to 240px, floating without a grid alongside hard-edged radial-gradient orbs and coin images; some pairs overlap. The logo and footer art are generated dot matrices.
references.layout: No visible grid: circles drift across each screen while text locks to the bottom corners (statement bottom-left, description bottom-right). A four-pill nav stays top-centre. The footer resolves into three text columns over a screen-filling dot-matrix glow.

sections.description: No grid. Circular photo crops between 60 and 240px across float over the grey-to-orange field, a few overlapping in pairs. A flat radial orb (orange rim, magenta-violet core, about 160px) sits among them and others are cut by the viewport edges. The pill nav stays top-centre; nothing else is fixed.

Bottom-left: a small bold date line, then a two-line statement in the outlined dot-matrix face at about 36px, some modules lit orange mid-animation. Bottom-right: a two-line 12px bold description. Above them three photo circles (190px portrait near centre, poster collage left, stage shot right) and a large orb top-right.

Grey field with a huge soft yellow radial glow. The dot-matrix logo is enlarged to fill the screen, its ellipses knocked out of the yellow in grey. On top: three columns of bold 18px text (contact message and email left, press list centre, socials right), a tiny credits list, and a bottom line with dates, year and city in the same three columns.

steal: Build the logotype from a dot matrix of ellipses of varying size, then reuse the same matrix at screen-filling scale as the footer background.
Crop every photo to a circle at wildly different diameters and let them float with coloured orbs instead of sitting in a gallery grid.
Fade each screen from flat grey into one saturated colour at its bottom edge so the viewport itself carries the brand colour.

references.name: Aevion
references.idea: One photoreal drone flies down the whole page through a white space organised only by hairlines and very light type.
references.hero: The first capture is the preloader: a white field with a tiny mono percentage counter dead centre. The loaded hero is white with a hairline-thin top bar: logo and a descriptor left, a credit and a live GMT clock in the middle, a small grey menu chip right. A pale blue-grey gradient panel fills the top 40% inside 12px margins. A white 3D drone hovers at centre, straddling a full-width hairline; a vertical hairline drops from it to the bottom edge. The headline is only 24px, two lines, far left, sitting on the horizontal rule with its second sentence greyed; a scroll cue sits far right on the same line.
references.type: Switzer in light weight (300) with -0.033em tracking for everything from the 24px headline to a single word at 16.7vw; protoMono at 12px in caps for bracketed labels and legal lines. Slate and pale grey mixed within one sentence. Four sizes.
references.colour: #fdfdfd #eef1f3 #24363f #a3abb0 #d5d9db — White on white with dark slate type and a paler grey for unrevealed words. The only tint is a faint blue-grey wash in the hero and the teal glint of the drone's lens. Cool.
references.imagery: A single white-and-grey quadcopter rendered live, with motion-blurred rotors, shown from front, three-quarter and side as it moves; often cropped by the right edge. Supporting graphics are hairline arcs and circles like a technical drawing.
references.layout: 12px page margins, content hung on a few full-width and half-width hairlines. Each screen holds one idea: a statement, a word, an object. Text stays left or lower-right while the drone travels between them. Nineteen screens of mostly white.

sections.description: White screen with a vertical hairline at 50% and a horizontal one near the bottom. Left half: a four-line statement at about 3vw in light grotesk, each word either dark slate or pale grey as a scroll-linked reveal passes through it. Right half: the drone in three-quarter view, cropped by the right edge and crossing the vertical rule.

A single noun set at 16.7vw in slate, top-left, the largest type on the page. A tiny mono label with a bullet sits far left at mid-height; a numbered chip sits top-right. The drone overlaps the right side at mid-height, and beneath it a 24px two-paragraph spec block occupies the right half, its later words still ghosted.

Landing diagram: the drone hovers above a drawing made only of hairlines: a large semicircular arc, a small circular target on the baseline, vertical dividers creating three bays, and a bracketed mono label above the target. Nothing else is on screen; the object and the drawing carry the whole frame.

Bracketed mono labels at both ends of a hairline, then a two-column row: a question at left, an answer plus a small square-cornered slate button at right. Below right, two short link lists in 12px; studio logo bottom-left; a mono legal line across the bottom edge.

steal: Use one hairline cross (a horizontal plus a vertical rule) as the only layout furniture and let the product render straddle it.
Set a single noun at 16vw as a chapter title and keep all explanatory copy at 24px, with nothing in between.
Reveal paragraphs word by word from pale grey to dark slate tied to scroll, so unread text stays visibly ghosted.
references.media: Every product view is real-time 3D: one fixed WebGL canvas carries the drone, centred at about 42% of the width inside an inset 1392x812 pale panel with a giant blurred wordmark behind it, then moves to the right half, then above a semicircle gauge, then inside a flat pale panel, while the HTML scrolls round it. The only photographic colour is one muted 8s clip filling the right half of a split.
references.motion: A numeric preloader counts for about 4.5s, then the page wipes up from the bottom by clip-path over 1670ms on a spring-shaped linear() ease, the ghost wordmark sharpens from a 200px blur over 2020ms, and the caption letters de-blur at a 50ms stagger. Lenis with two long pins (about 3.9 and 6.8 viewports) that step through three states each, swapping the drone's pose; statements scrub from grey to ink word by word, and buttons move over 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1).
